name: AWS first-seen: iam-enumerate-principals (behavioral)
description: Behavioral detection. Fires when (userIdentity.arn, eventName) is new for this principal in the last 90 days. Source rule: rules/discovery/iam-enumerate-principals.yml. Adjust field names to your Elastic CloudTrail mapping (e.g. aws.cloudtrail.* with the Fleet integration).
query: eventName:("ListUsers" or "ListRoles" or "ListGroups" or "ListPolicies" or "GetAccountSummary") and eventSource:"iam.amazonaws.com"
